pr_body:
Deprecated settings that are only set dynamically (i.e. not in elasticsearch.yml) could also be removed dynamically. This
PR adds information about these settings to the deprecation info API.
Closes #83116
pr_title: Add information about removable settings to the deprecation info API
pr_comment: Converted to a draft because I realized a shortcoming -- if a property is in elasticsearch.yml on one node but not on another (and it's also set as a dynamic setting), you'll get two separate DeprecationIssues in the response -- one saying you can fix it dynamically and one not saying that.
@dakrone I've broken up all long methods and tried to document what's going on a little better. Let me know if it makes more sense now.

> I think this LGTM, I left three pretty minor comments.
> 
> I do think we incur a bit of tech debt for this, but since it's 7.17 I think it's reasonable (tell me if you disagree!). I think that we will need to plan for this with whatever code we want to do this behavior with in the 8.x line.

Oh there's definitely new tech debt here due to the fact that `meta` is just a map of string to object, and that we're having to layer in meaning. I agree that it's fine for now, and better than the alternative of a major overhaul in 7.x. As we've discussed, we need to change `meta` into something more concrete in 8.x.

review_comment: Do we need the `UnknownAction` at all, or can we be strict and throw an exception if it's not in the format we expect? Do you think that would be too strict here? (especially since this `_meta` map the user has no control over, so I think we'd only be limiting plugins)
Yeah I was afraid I'd break some plugin that I don't know about. If you're certain that no one else is putting in any other `action`s, I can remove this.
This function feels really large, could you split it up into smaller pieces? Maybe a separate part for retrieving the leastCommonRemovableSettings?
